description: validation.rs has inline step comments numbered 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 (steps 4 and 5 are missing). A maintainer adding a validation step must guess where to insert it relative to the gap. Either renumber sequentially or remove step numbers from comments and use descriptive labels instead.
